summary: The root W-SH-Y primarily means to adorn or embellish something, often with various colors or patterns.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

parts.t: a piece of cloth, or a garment; (Mgh, Msb, * K;) and

headwords.def: وَشَى , inf. n. وَشْىٌ , He variegated, or figured, a piece of cloth, or a garment; (Mgh, Msb, * K;) and embellished it. (K.) وَشَى بِهِ إِلَى السُّلْطَانِ , (S, K,) or عِنْدَ السُّلْطَانِ , (Msb,) He calumniated, or misrepresented, him to the Sultán. (S, Msb, K.)

headwords.gloss: Any colour differing from the main colour; a colour differing from the rest; from that which generally pervades a thing

parts.t: Any colour differing from the main colour
a colour differing from the rest,
from that which generally pervades a thing.
It is of one generally pervading colour, in which is no other colour.
token, by which a thing is known;

headwords.def: شِيَةٌ Any colour differing from the main colour of a horse, &c.; a colour differing from the rest, (S,) or from that which generally pervades a thing. لَا شِيَةَ فِيهِ It is of one generally pervading colour, in which is no other colour. شِيَةٌ [also] A mark, sign, symptom, or token, by which a thing is known; syn. عَلَامَةٌ ; (Msb;) and مَخِيلَةٌ , which see.

headwords.gloss: A kind of variegated, or figured, cloth, or garment; variegation, figured work, or figuring; making

parts.t: A kind of variegated, or figured, cloth, or garment.

headwords.def: وَشْىٌ , originally an inf. n., A kind of variegated, or figured, cloth, or garment. (Mgh, Msb. *) وَشْىٌ The variegation, figured work, or figuring, of a garment; making it partycoloured. وَشى sometimes signifies A natural diversity of colours: see رُمْلَةٌ . وَشْىٌ of a sword: see فِرِنْدٌ .

parts.t: being restored; (S in the present art.;) and so

headwords.def: وَشَوِىٌّ rel. n. of شِيَةٌ , the rad. و being restored; (S in the present art.;) and so , like عِدَوِىٌّ [of عِدَةٌ ]. (S in art. وعد .)

headwords.gloss: A saying misrepresented; A musical reed-pipe

parts.t: is used by Aboo-Dhu-eyb to signify

headwords.def: قَوْلٌ مَوْشِىٌّ بِهِ [ A saying misrepresented ]. (TA in art. قت , in an explanation of قَوْلٌ مَقْتُوتٌ .) مَوْشِىٌّ is used by Aboo-Dhu-eyb to signify A musical reed-pipe. (TA, art. نوب .)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
